messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Turkish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Turkish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Turkish) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | mosse | first hour / initial moment | **saatinde** | “in the hour” | OK | | di (1) | genitive “of” (linking *mosse* to *prima*) | **zamanın** (genitive suffix) | “of time” | UNNECESSARY | | prima | “first” (temporal) | **ilk** | “first” | OK | | quelle | demonstrative “those” (modifying *cose*) | — (omitted, encoded in “tatlı”) | “those” | UNNECESSARY | | cose | “things” (beautiful entities) | **mevsim** | “season” | OK | | belle | “beautiful” (quality of *cose*) | **tatlı** | “sweet” | OK | | sì | resultative adverb “so” | **böyle** | “so” | OK | | ch’a (che + a) | causal conjunction “that … to” | **ki** | “that … to” | OK | | bene | “good” (quality of hope) | **iyi** | “good” | OK | | sperar | infinitive “to hope” | **umut beslemek** | “to nurture hope” | OK | | m’era | clitic + copula “to me was” (experiencer) | **bana** | “to me” | OK | | cagione | “occasion, reason” | **neden** | “reason” | OK | | di (2) | preposition “of / concerning” introducing the beast | — (omitted, encoded in demonstrative) | “of” | UNNECESSARY | | quella | demonstrative “that” (referring to the beast) | **bu** | “this/that” | OK | | fiera | “wild beast” | **vahşi hayvan** | “wild animal” | OK | | a (3) | preposition “with” (attribute of skin) | — (omitted, expressed by adjective) | “with” | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article “the” (for *pelle*) | — (no article in Turkish) | “the” | UNNECESSARY | | gaetta | “dappled, speckled” (describing skin) | **benekli** | “dappled” | OK | | pelle | “skin” (attribute of the beast) | **derili** | “skinned / with skin” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: - *di* (both occurrences) – Turkish expresses the genitive/possessive with suffixes, no separate preposition. - *quelle* – demonstrative omitted; meaning carried by the adjective *tatlı*. - *di* (second) – omitted, encoded in the demonstrative *bu*. - *a* (preposition) – omitted, rendered as the adjective *benekli*. - *la* – Turkish lacks definite articles.
- **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Turkish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Turkish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: **zamanın ilk saatinde ve tatlı mevsimde;** - Issue: none - Corrected: **zamanın ilk saatinde ve tatlı mevsimde;**
- Line 2: - Original: **böyle ki bana iyi umut beslemek bir neden oldu** - Issue: none - Corrected: **böyle ki bana iyi umut beslemek bir neden oldu**
- Line 3: - Original: **bu benekli derili vahşi hayvan hakkında** - Issue: none - Corrected: **bu benekli derili vahşi hayvan hakkında**
``` zamanın ilk saatinde ve tatlı mevsimde; böyle ki bana iyi umut beslemek bir neden oldu bu benekli derili vahşi hayvan hakkında ```
